model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.5 r1 — Regolith Capital
notes: v7.7.5: regolith extraction capacity is simple capital (a simple_capital node per colony, model/nodes/regolith-mine.json), sized to a new smoothed regolith demand-signal stock; the first sector generated from a node declaration of type simple_capital. See docs/tasks/017-regolith-capital/.
Modes 0-37 reproduce v7.7.4 r1 exactly (Regolith Capital Enabled = 0); Mode 38 baseline (A mine grows, then disposes of surplus), Mode 39 transport surge in which colony B rebuilds its regolith mine.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
